summary: Tested the retirement of the legacy Connect telecalling module. Backend: 42/42 pytest checks passed. 21 retired GET paths and 6 retired POST paths (activity/ping, call-sessions/start, call-logs, attendance/check-in, follow-ups, leave/request) return 410 with a 'retired' detail, including unauthenticated requests. 10 kept admin endpoints and 3 kept TL endpoints return 200. The regex does not catch /api/leads list, /api/tl/meta, /api/files/dashboard/stats or /api/meta/*. Frontend: tested admin, manager, TL (mobile 390x844) and GP. Each lands on <section>/files. Nav and More menus match the spec. All 41 old bookmarks tested redirect to <section>/files (admin 12, manager 9, TL 11; plus /agent/team and /agent/team/files for GP, which correctly bounce to /agent/files). Kept pages load: admin users/approvals/legacy-mapping/settings/customers-campaigns/quality report, file detail, check-eligibility, Meta dashboard plus leads/files/reports/call-logs/inbox, manager My Team, TL My Team/Team Files/Profile, GP own files (15). The Create File modal opens for TL and GP (cancelled, not submitted, so no data created). Across all screens: 0 requests to retired APIs, 0 HTTP 410s, 0 API 4xx/5xx, no app console errors (only visual-editor hydration warnings from injected <span> inside <select>/<option>).

minor.issue: Not part of this change. Auth uses a Bearer token only (no app httpOnly cookie). CORS returns Access-Control-Allow-Origin '*' together with allow-credentials true. No brute-force lockout: 6 bad logins all returned 401.

issues: Member cards still show legacy telecalling metrics 'Calls', 'Leads'/'Data' (always 0) and 'Active Today'. These numbers are meaningless now that telecalling is retired. Suggest hiding them and keeping Files/Disbursed.
Role label shows 'Telecaller' for a growth_partner TL
A GP sees the 'All Managers / All Team Leads / All Growth Partners' filters, which don't apply to their own files
On mobile (390px) the 'All Status' and 'All Growth Partners' selects overflow the filter card's right edge

action_items: Optional: remove the legacy Calls/Leads/Data/Active Today stats from the ManagerTeam and TeamMembers cards

Optional cleanup: retired page and component files are still in the bundle but no longer routed (pages/admin/Dashboard.js, Attendance.js, LeaveManagement.js, Reports.js, DailyTrackingSheet.js, telecaller/Dashboard.js, FollowUps.js, Attendance.js, team/TeamLeads.js, TeamData.js, TeamCalls.js, LeadDetail.js, manager/ManagerDashboard.js, components/CallModal.js, PostCallModal.js, TodaysCallActivity.js, VerifiedCallStats.js, components/attendance/*, services/offlineQueue.js). Delete them to stop accidental reuse.
Optional: Profile role label for growth_partner
critical_code_review_comments: server.py retire_legacy_telecalling middleware: the regex is anchored and correctly scoped. It runs before auth, so any client gets 410 (intended).
App.js retiredRoutes(): uses relative child paths under each section and also covers 'leads/:id'. No unknown sub-paths found leaking into retired pages.
Dead code: the retired modules listed in action_items still call the retired APIs. They are harmless now (not imported by any route), but they add bundle weight.
seed_data_creation: None. No files created (the Create File modal was opened and cancelled). Visiting /admin/files/{id}/check-eligibility automatically re-runs the eligibility analysis for that file (existing behaviour), which may add an eligibility history entry for file c36d3b05-97e1-4730-a635-183341de0a12.
